additional_info.subject: 0467260 - ID0467260/DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2/T3314176150001] Check on logs CRM:00472000468
additional_info.body:
Dear Rosita,
The failed attempts to charge yesterday, were related for the OCPP being toggling between OFFLINE and ONLINE. Most probably related with a problem on the network provider.
The charger couldn't process the authorization because the OCPP server was not reachable. Without it, the session can not start. Today I see no instability and everything looks fine in the charger.
Since there is no action to be done, I will proceed to close this ticket if you agree.
With best regards,
Joao Francisco Louro Cardoso
Siemens S.A.
SI E CS SD L3
201, Avenida 25 de Abril
2845-547 Corroios, Portugal
mailto:joao.louro-cardoso@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
